section.p: The Vibration X (vibx) is the vibration acceleration measured in the tangential direction of the motor. This recorded data shows the vibration X waveform data, in the unit of metre per second squared (m/s2).

li.p: Each record contains an array of 15,000 samples captured on the specified timestamp.
The X-axis data is a vector of 15,000 data points with a step of 0.00016s.
The following two datasets, vibration Z (vibz) and magnetic field (flux), also use the same time stamp to generate the waveform graphic. All 3 datasets, vibx, vibz
For more information on API refer to the ADI OtoSense ™ SMS REST API.
